description: All operator licences held by one company or organisation, by Companies House number (e.g. 02155951 or SC096849): totals of licences, vehicles, trailers and operating centres, each licence with its status and continuation date, Companies House status (liquidation, administration, receivership, accounts overdue; dissolved only when verified by number and name), earned recognition, public inquiries, Traffic Commissioner decisions and Gazette notices.

company_number.description: Companies House number, e.g. 02155951 or SC096849

name: get_company

attribution.description: Attribution text to show with the data

canonical_url.description: The human-readable HaulierScope page for this result

dissolved_verified.description: Companies House reports the company dissolved, checked by company number AND name. Never inferred from a number missing in the live-company file

name_mismatch.description: The registered name is unlike the DVSA operator name: the company number on the DVSA record may belong to another company, so the other facts are omitted

not_found_in_live_file.description: The company number was not found in the Companies House live-company file (unverified: often a mistyped DVSA number). Not the same as dissolved

register_date.description: Companies House register date these facts describe

status.description: Company status code (active, liquidation, administration, receivership, dissolved, not_on_register, …)

list_date.description: Date of DVSA's earned recognition list

holder_type.description: company = limited company or LLP; other = public body, charity or similar; sole_trader_or_partnership = an individual (name never published here)

category.description: goods = goods vehicles (HGV); psv = buses and coaches

status.description: Licence status in the DVSA file. 'unmapped' = a status code we have not mapped yet; never treat it as valid.

grounds.description: Legislation the inquiry is called under, as published

publication.description: Traffic Commissioner publication (Applications and Decisions, or Notices and Proceedings)

withheld.description: True when the record is withheld at the holder's request: no other details are given

file_date.description: Date of the DVSA operator licence file the data describes (null before the first import)

markdown_url.description: Markdown version of the canonical page

retrieved_at.description: When this response was generated (ISO timestamp)

source.description: Data source(s) the result is built from

source_url.description: Where the primary source dataset is published

title: Get a company's operator licences
